title: Software Engineer & Open Source Maintainer (Remote)
description: Kevnnard Labs is my personal open source brand: it is not a company and does not represent any company. Under it I publish my own open source tools and self-funded indie products, taking each one from idea to release — architecture, code, distribution and product. Recent work: devtrainer (daily coding practice with spaced repetition), english-teacher (an English teacher in the terminal), watts (electricity use and cost dashboard, in progress) and lgswitch (LG ultrawide input switching), all in Go and shipped through a Homebrew tap; plus private tools such as Jarvis (terminal focus assistant), Calls AI (native macOS live call assistant in Swift) and Trading (crypto charts terminal, in progress). Earlier projects include Mis Gastos – Mis Cuentas (iOS accounting app with real users), Smart Window (SwiftUI macOS, open source), dots and this 3D portfolio.

title: Lead Software Engineer & Co-founder (Remote)
description: Co-founded THREE LABS S.A.S., a software agency built on a 5-person team (2 founders + 3 independent contractors). We shipped end-to-end software products: custom SaaS platforms, mobile apps, e-commerce storefronts, and DevOps. Flagship products include Three Trackr (multi-carrier shipment tracking at app.threeelabs.com), Three Shopify (Shopify storefronts and integrations), Three X (clothing retail), and Grupor (inventory management). I led technical direction across the stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Astro on the frontend; NestJS, Node.js, and Express on the backend; PostgreSQL and Supabase for data; AWS for deployments. I also drove QA automation and testing strategy across mobile and web.
